$schema_note: tällmi brand tokens, decided with the owner on 2026-10-20 (docs/brand.md). Source of truth for colour, type, tälli's look and motion. The app must read these through the config layer (seed JSON), never hard-code them in Swift. Times are seconds, sizes are fractions of the referenced size unless a unit is named.

paper.role: page behind your thoughts; macOS window colour may replace it

mist.note: fill only, never text; ink on mist is 13.86

pink.role: only the dots: tälli's eyes, the ä in the logo, the listening pulse

paper.role: night surface for tällmi's own views; also the icon ground's core

blue.note: white on this blue is only 2.74, so labels on blue use the night colour

mist.note: fill only; ink on mist is 12.13

rules: Pink is used for the two dots and nothing else.
Everything not listed follows macOS: system greys, materials, Liquid Glass.
Text must reach 4.5:1 (WCAG AA); the dots and other graphics 3:1.

glyph.note: the softened ä: the real Funnel Display a, inflated by a round-joined stroke of 7 % of the font size in the same fill

eyes.color: pink (dark-mode pink on night grounds, light-mode pink on paper)
eyes.note: fractions of the font size. The eyes are always two solid pink dots.

fill.space: glyph bounding box, x right, y down

overlays.name: key
overlays.note: soft tint from the top left, never white

overlays.name: bounce
overlays.note: light bouncing back from the ground, so the bottom right lifts instead of going dark

body.overlay_space: center in glyph bounding box; radius as a fraction of the font size; painted only on the body (source-atop)

mouth.where: the lower counter of the a
mouth.note: x as a fraction of glyph width, y as a fraction of x-height above the baseline; it opens only when tälli says something

letters.note: the thinking äh: letters grow out of the ä in the body material, at 62 % of the ä's size

app_icon.shape: macOS 26 squircle (Icon Composer); corner radius about 22.5 % in previews
app_icon.ground: talli.ground_night, plus a 10 % mist sheen fading out over the top half

talli.note: the softened ä fills the tile and is cut off by the bottom edge; the eyes look up at you

app_icon.motion: The Dock icon is still. It may blink once at launch; the menu bar dots may glance and blink.

wordmark.note: the soft eyes wordmark (2b). The i keeps an ink dot. Always lowercase.

base.note: every size below is relative to this, so all of them follow the macOS text-size setting

display.moment.use: the one loud thing per screen: a month, a constellation name

text.thought.use: your thought, at reading size (15 pt at default)

rules: One loud thing per screen, and it is not too loud.
Your own text is never animated, rotated or set in display type.

spring.appear.use: A1 rise: one soft overshoot, then still

time_of_day.source: the Mac's clock only, nothing recorded

motion.reduce_motion: tälli is a still face. Entrances and exits become a 0.26 s / 0.20 s fade. No breathing, swell, drift, blink or glance. While listening the dots brighten and dim with your voice; thinking letters fade in place; crossfades stay.

rules: Only on a Force Touch trackpad, and only for moments you caused.
No haptic for appearing, thinking or listening.
